decks.provenance_note: PROVENANCE UNCONFIRMED -- likely a business-school case study, NOT the company's own raise deck. Do not treat as ground truth about Mint. Evidence: slide 1 is four personal names plus a date (Joanne Chen | Michael D'Orazio | Victor Ho | Alan Rutledge, April 20 2007) rather than a company title; the deck contains Exit Strategy, Exit Calculation, Competitive Response and Financial Assumptions slides, which are analyst sections rather than founder sections; and the body refers to the company in the third person ("Mint's Comp. Advantages", "Mint's Defensibility"). A founder pitching does not compute their own exit. Mint was founded by Aaron Patzer, who is not named anywhere in the file. Retained for heading-robustness testing only (it is a real PDF with real unconventional headings); excluded from any measurement that treats the deck as evidence about the company.
